# apicurio_artifact (Resource)

An artifact and, when `content` is set, its latest version.

Without `content` the resource manages the artifact's metadata only (name, description, labels, owner); versions are then created by `apicurio_artifact_version` resources or outside Terraform. With `content`, the resource creates the first version on create and a new version whenever the configured content (or `references`) stops being the same document as the stored latest version: versions are immutable, so a change is always a new version, numbered by the registry. A version created outside Terraform shows up as a diff of `content`, and the next apply creates another version so that the latest version matches the configuration again. Do not manage the versions of one artifact with both this resource's `content` and `apicurio_artifact_version` resources.

The group is created by the registry when it does not exist (default server setting). Deleting the artifact deletes all its versions and needs `apicurio.rest.deletion.artifact.enabled=true` on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An artifact whose latest version follows a schema file: every change of
# the file creates a new version, numbered by the registry.
resource "apicurio_artifact" "price" {
  group_id    = apicurio_group.payments.group_id
  artifact_id = "price"
  name        = "Price"
  description = "Price of an item, published on the prices topic"
  labels = {
    topic = "prices"
  }

  # The registry detects AVRO from the content; set artifact_type and
  # content_type explicitly for content it cannot sniff.
  content = file("${path.module}/schemas/price.avsc")
}

# An artifact that references another one by its Avro type name.
resource "apicurio_artifact" "order" {
  group_id    = apicurio_group.payments.group_id
  artifact_id = "order"
  content     = file("${path.module}/schemas/order.avsc")

  references = [{
    group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
    artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
    version     = apicurio_artifact.price.version
    name        = "com.example.Price"
  }]
}

# Metadata only: the versions are managed elsewhere (or by
# apicurio_artifact_version resources).
resource "apicurio_artifact" "events" {
  group_id      = apicurio_group.payments.group_id
  artifact_id   = "events"
  artifact_type = "PROTOBUF"
  name          = "Payment events"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (String) Identifier of the artifact within the group (1 to 512 characters). Changing it replaces the artifact.
- `group_id` (String) Group of the artifact (no `/`). Changing it replaces the artifact.

### Optional

- `artifact_type` (String) Type of the artifact: `AVRO`, `PROTOBUF`, `JSON`, `KCONNECT`, `OPENAPI`, `ASYNCAPI`, `GRAPHQL`, `WSDL`, `XSD`, `XML`, or any type the registry registers (checked against `GET /admin/config/artifactTypes`). When unset, the registry detects it from `content`; it is then required when there is no `content`. Changing it replaces the artifact.
- `content` (String) Content of the latest version, usually `file("schema.avsc")`. When set, the latest version of the artifact is kept equal to it (a change creates a new version). Compared as a document: reformatting JSON or YAML, changing line endings or trailing whitespace is not a change. When unset, the attribute shows the latest version's content without managing it. An empty string is refused.
- `content_type` (String) Media type of `content`. Defaults by artifact type: `application/json` for `AVRO`, `JSON`, `KCONNECT` and JSON `OPENAPI`/`ASYNCAPI`, `application/x-yaml` for YAML `OPENAPI`/`ASYNCAPI`, `application/x-protobuf` for `PROTOBUF`, `application/graphql` for `GRAPHQL`, `application/xml` for `XSD`, `WSDL`, `XML`; sniffed from the content when `artifact_type` is unset (the registry needs the right hint to detect the type). The registry stores content by hash and reports the media type of the first upload of those bytes, so the configured value is kept in state and changing only `content_type` does not create a new version.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels (key/value pairs) of the artifact.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `owner` (String) Owner of the artifact. Defaults to the user the provider authenticates as.
- `references` (Attributes List) References from the content to other artifact versions (the Avro named types, Protobuf imports or JSON Schema `$ref`s it uses). Part of the version: a change creates a new version. Requires `content`, and `artifact_type` should be set: the registry cannot detect the type of content whose named types live in other artifacts. Order does not matter. When unset, a new version keeps the references of the stored latest version; set `[]` to drop them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--references))

### Read-Only

- `content_id` (Number) Content id of the latest version (shared by versions with identical content).
- `created_on` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `global_id` (Number) Global id of the latest version.
- `id` (String) `group_id/artifact_id`.
- `modified_by` (String) User of the last metadata modification.
- `modified_on` (String) Last modification time of the metadata (RFC 3339).
- `version` (String) Version id of the latest version (numbered by the registry). Null for an artifact without versions.

<a id="nestedatt--references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `references`

Required:

- `artifact_id` (String) Referenced artifact.
- `group_id` (String) Group of the referenced artifact.
- `name` (String) Name the content uses for the reference (for example the fully qualified Avro type name).
- `version` (String) Referenced version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Artifacts are imported by "group_id/artifact_id"; the group id cannot
# contain a slash, the artifact id may. The import reads the metadata and
# the latest version, so a configuration with the same content shows no diff.
terraform import apicurio_artifact.price payments/price
```
